meta_description: Chris Decorating Services in Nottingham offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Reliable local tradesman. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From fresh interior paint to complete exterior makeovers, we transform your Nottingham home with expert craftsmanship and attention to detail.
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or a whole-house renovation, we handle interior painting, exterior work, wallpapering, and specialist finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, woodwork, ceilings — we prep thoroughly, use premium paints, and deliver a finish that lasts. Includes colour consultation to get it exactly right.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with quality exterior paint and rendered finishes. We prepare surfaces properly to ensure long-lasting protection against Nottingham's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Coverings
services.desc: Pattern or plain, we hang wallpaper, vinyl, and specialist coverings with precision. Expert pattern matching and sealing for a seamless result.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architrave, and fitted furniture — we sand, prime, and paint to a professional standard. Durable finishes that resist chipping and wear.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Textured coatings, faux effects, feature walls, and decorative techniques. Transform a room with bespoke finishes tailored to your style.

services.title: Commercial & Property Maintenance
services.desc: Landlord redecoration, office refreshes, and rental property turnover. We work efficiently to minimise downtime and keep costs predictable.

about_pullquote: A fresh coat of paint shouldn't break the bank or drag on for weeks.
about_para_1: Chris Decorating Services was established over 20 years ago by Chris, a time-served tradesman who got tired of seeing homeowners overcharged by big firms. Based in Gedling, Nottingham, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time — delivering quality finishes on time and on budget. Every project, whether it's a single room or a whole house, gets the same meticulous preparation and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we listen, we quote fairly, and we show up when we say we will. We use quality materials, we respect your home, and we tidy up properly after ourselves. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals — that's something we're genuinely proud of.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Chris came out and gave us a realistic quote for redecorating our lounge and hallway. He turned up on the day he promised, was tidy, efficient, and the finish was excellent. Fair price too. Would absolutely have him back.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had a real nightmare trying to find someone reliable to wallpaper our feature wall and paint the rest of the room. Chris got the pattern matching spot on and didn't rush the job. He's a proper craftsman. Brilliant.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Exterior paintwork on our 1930s semi needed doing badly. Chris prepped it all properly, didn't cut corners, and the result looks fresh as new. He explained what he was doing and why, which gave me confidence. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rachel H.
